national_news.title: PM Modi Dedicated Western Dedicated Freight Corridor Sections and Projects Worth ₹35,000 Crore
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated three key sections of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC) in Vadodara, marking the operationalisation of the over 2,800 km Dedicated Freight Corridor network.

Inaugurated and laid foundation stones for projects worth over ₹35,000 crore, including ₹9,700 crore for railway expansion and ₹1,780 crore for National Highway projects across Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
Flagged off new freight services from New Sanand, New Makarpura, New Umbergaon, and New JNPT, alongside a new passenger train service connecting Tanda Road to Vadodara.

national_news.title: DAC Approves Capital Procurement Proposals Worth Over ₹1.10 Lakh Crore for Armed Forces
bullets: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, cleared capital acquisition proposals worth over ₹1.10 lakh crore for the Indian Armed Forces.
Over 98% of the total approved procurements will be sourced directly from the domestic Indian industry to boost self-reliance in defence manufacturing.
Approved procurements include CBRN Recce Vehicles, Advanced Light Helicopters (ALHs), Arudhra Radars, Marine Gas Turbines, Ground-Based Multi-Purpose Jammers, and RFID-based DEFSAC smart cards.

national_news.title: India Joins Global 25-Nation Initiative on Next-Generation 6G Technology
bullets: India joined the United States and 24 other nations in a global initiative focused on developing and shaping next-generation 6G telecommunications standards.
The alliance was announced following bilateral discussions between MoS Commerce Jitin Prasada and US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at the G20 Innovation Ministerial in North Carolina, USA.
Bilateral discussions focused on expanding cooperation in artificial intelligence, semiconductors, data centers, and US investments under India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0.

national_news.title: International Literacy Day Celebrated Globally on 8th September
bullets: International Literacy Day is observed globally every year on September 8th, following its proclamation by UNESCO in 1966.
The theme for the celebration is 'Literacy for people, the planet and prosperity'.
UNESCO organized the main global conference in collaboration with the Government of Mexico, focusing on the Action Plan for the UNESCO Global Alliance for Literacy Strategy (2026–2029).

national_news.title: India-Russia Bilateral Ties Highlighted Ahead of 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi
bullets: Bilateral trade between India and Russia reached $68.7 billion, driven heavily by energy imports, with Russia's share in India's crude oil imports rising to 35% in FY25.
New Delhi is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in September 2026, focusing on economic resilience, innovation, and sustainable technology partnerships.
Both nations are expanding Rupee-Rouble settlement mechanisms, connectivity corridors like INSTC and Chennai-Vladivostok route, and negotiating an India-EAEU Free Trade Agreement.

national_news.title: PM-SETU Approves ₹735.70 Crore Investment Plans for ITI Clusters in Three States
bullets: The National Steering Committee under PM-SETU approved ₹735.70 crore for ITI clusters in Bhiwadi (Rajasthan), Medchal (Telangana), and Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), taking total scheme approvals to ₹2,171 crore across nine clusters.
Chaired by Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) Secretary Debashree Mukherjee, the scheme upgrades Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) using an industry-led hub model.
Rajasthan became the first state to execute a Shareholders' Agreement (SHA) under PM-SETU with MSDE and private partner H.G. Infra Engineering for cluster implementation.

national_news.title: India Participates in G20 Innovation Ministers' Meeting in Chapel Hill, USA
bullets: Union Minister of State Jitin Prasada led the Indian delegation at the G20 Innovation Ministers’ meeting in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, US.

The meeting adopted the Innovation Ministerial Statement based on six pillars, along with the 'Carolina Principles for Emerging Technologies', 'AI Prosperity Objectives', and the 'AI Prosperity Compact'.

India held bilateral discussions with representatives from the EU, France, Germany, African Union (offering India Stack digital solutions), and the US Secretary of Commerce on semiconductors, AI, and data centres.

national_news.title: Government Keeps PLI Scheme for Public Sector Bank Executives in Abeyance
bullets: Union Finance Minister met with a delegation of bank employees representing Public Sector Banks (PSBs) led by the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh.
In response to employee representations, the government decided to keep the implementation of the Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (dated 19.11.2024) in abeyance for FY 2025–26.
The PLI structure and related employee concerns will be revisited during the ongoing Bipartite Settlement and Joint Note discussions.

national_news.title: PM Modi inaugurates key infrastructure projects in Gujarat and launches Global Fintech Fest 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated three key sections (326 route km) of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC) built at over ₹20,700 crore, marking its full completion.
Laid foundation stones and dedicated projects worth over ₹35,000 crore in Vadodara, including a 110 MW floating solar plant at Kadana Dam and railway/highway expansion worth over ₹11,400 crore.
Inaugurated the 7th Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026 in Mumbai under the theme 'Potential to Impact: Agentic AI, Tokenisation, Quantum – Trusted, Connected, Global Systems for Inclusive Finance'.

national_news.title: Govt Puts PSB Performance Linked Incentive Scheme for FY 2025–26 in Abeyance
bullets: Union Finance Minister met a Public Sector Bank (PSB) employee delegation led by the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh to discuss key service and welfare concerns.
The Ministry of Finance decided to keep the implementation of the Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (dated 19.11.2024) for FY 2025–26 in abeyance.
The PLI structure, along with ex-gratia review and medical facilities for retired employees, will be deliberated during ongoing Bipartite Settlement/Joint Note discussions.

national_news.title: Sheetal Devi Reaches Final at World Archery Para Series Stage 3
bullets: World champion Sheetal Devi secured a medal for India by advancing to the women's compound individual final at the World Archery Para Series in Ahmedabad.
She defeated fellow Indian archer Sarita 145-143 in the semifinals to set up a gold medal clash with Kazakhstan's Aizada Seidan.
The tournament features archers across compound and W1 categories, where W1 refers to athletes with impairments in at least three limbs.

national_news.title: Commerce Minister Urges Pharma Sector to Leverage Free Trade Agreements
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal inaugurated the Pharma Mach Tech and Labnext Expo 2026 in New Delhi.
He called on the pharmaceutical and medical devices industry to utilize India's Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) to position India as a global healthcare hub.
He highlighted the need to strengthen the startup incubation ecosystem for medtech, intellectual property frameworks, and self-reliance in drug research.

national_news.title: Kerala Media Delegation Begins Seven-Day Press Tour to Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: A 13-member media delegation from Kerala is undertaking a seven-day press tour to Jammu and Kashmir from September 6 to 12, 2026.
The tour is organized by the Press Information Bureau (PIB), Kochi, to provide journalists first-hand insights into developmental and infrastructure initiatives in J&K.
The itinerary includes briefings by PIB Srinagar officials and visits to key locations such as Gulmarg.

national_news.title: India and Luxembourg Strengthen Strategic Partnership Across Key Sectors
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Luxembourg's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Xavier Bettel in New Delhi to review bilateral ties.
Key discussion areas included financial cooperation, trade, investment, space technology, digital infrastructure, green technologies, and healthcare.
Luxembourg reaffirmed its strong support for the swift conclusion and ratification of the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA).

national_news.title: Union Environment Minister Engages 63 NCR Urban Bodies for 'Clean Air Mission'
bullets: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav led a dialogue with Mayors and local representatives from 63 National Capital Region (NCR) cities to tackle air pollution.
Emphasized strict grassroots enforcement of Solid Waste Management Rules and Construction & Demolition (C&D) Waste Management Rules by urban local bodies.
Highlighted the role of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) as a centralized institutional mechanism for technical support and air quality enforcement in the NCR.

national_news.title: 11th Ayurveda Day 2026 Launched as a National Health Campaign
bullets: Union Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare Prataprao Jadhav announced the campaign for the 11th Ayurveda Day at the National Media Centre, New Delhi.
The campaign focuses on three core pillars: Integrative Healthcare for Better Health Outcomes, Evidence/Research/Innovation in Ayurveda, and Ayurveda for Community Wellbeing and Sustainable Living.

Key highlights include the presentation of the National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards 2026 and initiatives by the National Institute of Ayurveda (NIA), Jaipur, including safety dossiers on medicinal plants and treatment guidelines for skin diseases.

national_news.title: Government Enhances DBT & Aadhaar Delivery for SC Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment reviewed the implementation of the Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste (SC) students.

Fund disbursement relies on Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), introduced in 2021-22, and mandatory Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) to ensure transparent beneficiary targeting and de-duplication.
The Central government share is released strictly upon the disbursement of the corresponding State/UT share and verification of beneficiary data on the central portal.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Extends Student Credit Card Scheme Till FY 2030-31
bullets: The Bihar government extended the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme for five additional years, making it operational until the financial year 2030-31.

Under the scheme administered by the Department of Education, eligible Bihar residents who passed Class 12 can access education loans up to Rs 4 lakh for higher education courses like MBBS, B.Tech, B.Sc, and B.A.
The state cabinet approved Rs 950 crore for the current financial year to disburse education loans, adding to the total 4.15 lakh students supported so far.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Pitching Investment Opportunities at AIM Congress in Dubai
bullets: A delegation led by Bihar Industries Minister Ms. Shreyasi Singh represented the state at the Annual Investment Meeting (AIM) Congress held in Dubai.
The state pitch highlighted Bihar's expanding road connectivity, surplus power supply, human resources, and supportive government policies to attract global investors.
The participation aimed at driving international investments into industrial development, infrastructure projects, and job creation in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: UK Recognises India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme Under CBAM
bullets: The United Kingdom has included India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), administered by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency under the Ministry of Power, in its recognized overseas carbon pricing list under CBAM Regulations 2026.

Indian exporters will be able to claim relief on UK CBAM liability for carbon prices paid domestically, protecting exports of iron, steel, aluminium, fertilisers, hydrogen, ceramics, glass, and cement.
The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is set to officially begin on January 1, 2027, targeting carbon-intensive imports.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Establish Dedicated Teacher Training University and AI Ecosystem
bullets: The Bihar government announced the establishment of a dedicated Teacher Training University to provide regular skill development for over seven lakh educators across primary to higher education levels.
The state has partnered with tech giants including Microsoft, Google, and Sarvam AI to build a modern AI ecosystem, finalizing an MoU with Google for AI-focused teacher training.
Plans are also being explored to open a Banaras Hindu University (BHU) centre in Bihar to expand access to higher education.

bihar_news.title: Tejashwi Yadav urges Centre to declare Bihar floods a national disaster
bullets: RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi urging him to declare the severe floods in Bihar as a national disaster.
Demanded an immediate financial assistance of Rs 5,000 crore and a special flood-relief package for the affected districts.
Highlighted that over a dozen districts (around 20 districts) are affected, disrupting connectivity, agriculture, and public infrastructure, and called for a long-term Flood Resilience Mission.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Records Significant Improvement in Maternal and Newborn Healthcare in NFHS-6
bullets: According to NFHS-6 data, institutional deliveries in Bihar increased from 76.2% to 81.1%, with government hospitals accounting for 57.5% of overall deliveries (58.4% in rural areas).
First-trimester Antenatal Care (ANC) coverage rose from 52.9% to 63.9%, while women receiving at least one ANC service reached 94%.
Postnatal care for mothers within two days of delivery expanded from 57.3% to 69.9%, while early care for newborns within 48 hours grew from 59.3% to 76.2%.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Agriculture Department Announces Machinery Subsidy for Sugarcane Farmers
bullets: The Bihar Agriculture Department announced a 40% to 50% subsidy covering 44 types of sugarcane machinery to benefit 3,173 farmers in sugarcane-producing districts.
Selected farmers are required to purchase the approved equipment within 30 days of permit issuance, following which the subsidy will be transferred directly to their bank accounts via DBT.
The initiative covers key sugarcane hubs across the state, including all four districts of the Tirhut Division such as Muzaffarpur.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Floods Inundate 13 Districts Affecting 27 Lakh People
bullets: Inundations across 13 districts in Bihar have affected approximately 27 lakh people following heavy rainfall and overflowing rivers including Ganga, Gandak, and Kosi.
The state administration set up 190 community kitchens and deployed 1,429 relief boats to assist flood victims in affected areas like Vaishali and Bhagalpur.
At Patna's Gandhi Ghat, the Ganga River reached 50.41 metres, flowing 1.57 metres above the danger mark after the state recorded 69.1 mm rainfall in early September.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Hears Plea to Regulate Airfare Fluctuations
bullets: A Supreme Court bench comprising Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta heard a petition seeking regulatory guidelines to control erratic airfares and ancillary fees.
The Union Government informed the apex court regarding the framing of rules under the newly enacted Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024.
The petition highlights the need for an independent civil aviation regulator to enforce airfare rationalization and ensure passenger protection.

bihar_news.title: Vice President Launches National India Valve Registry in Chennai
bullets: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan launched the India Valve Registry during the 9th edition of the India Valves conference in Chennai.
The registry operates as a multicentre national database for collecting de-identified real-world clinical data on patient outcomes in heart valve interventions.
It aims to bridge the long-standing gap in tracking regional clinical variations, patient demographics, and long-term outcomes for structural heart disease treatments in India.

bihar_news.title: RVNL Secures ₹903 Crore Infrastructure Contract for Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) received a Letter of Award worth ₹903.01 crore from SJVN Thermal Private Limited for infrastructure work in Bihar.
The contract entails constructing a permanent railway siding and aerial track connections linking the plant boundary to Chausa and Pawani Kamarpur in Buxar district.
The infrastructure project supports the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project and has a designated execution timeline of 36 months.

bihar_news.title: India Achieves 21% Drop in TB Incidence Under National TB Elimination Programme
bullets: India recorded a 21% reduction in Tuberculosis (TB) incidence between 2015 and 2024, falling from 237 to 187 cases per lakh population according to the WHO Global TB Report 2025.
During the same period, TB mortality decreased by 25% while treatment coverage expanded significantly from 53% to 92% under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP).
Key initiatives driving TB management include the Ni-kshay digital platform, Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana, portable Truenat molecular diagnostics, and shorter drug regimens like Bedaquiline and Pretomanid.

bihar_news.title: Ganga Breaches All-Time High Flood Level Record at Gandhi Ghat in Patna
bullets: The Ganga River surpassed its historical maximum flood level at Gandhi Ghat in Patna, reaching 50.57 meters and breaching the previous record of 50.52 meters set in August 2016.
Severe flooding affected over 22.42 lakh people across 12 Bihar districts, with rivers including Gandak, Kosi, Burhi Gandak, Punpun, and Bagmati flowing above danger levels.
Water levels at Pandarak reached 43.92 meters (surpassing the 2021 record of 43.73 meters), prompting downstream alerts in Munger, Kahalgaon, and Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Evolution and Major Infrastructure Projects of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited
bullets: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) was incorporated on January 24, 2003, under the Ministry of Railways following the National Rail Vikas Yojana launched in 2002.
RVNL achieved Category-I Mini Ratna status in 2013 and was elevated to Navratna CPSE status in 2023.

Key national engineering projects by RVNL include Tamil Nadu's New Pamban Bridge, the 125-km Rishikesh-Karnaprayag Rail Link, BharatNet's Middle-Mile Network, and Rajasthan's Mahi Bajaj Sagar irrigation project.
